2.content:
Schedule New Patient Appointment (227319134, org 605418)

Purpose

The scheduling path for a new Ivy Rehab patient. Entered from Incoming Call node 52. Collects the patient, the referral, the insurance and the appointment, then hands back.

Node map - insurance path

 31 Collect DOB (Tree) -> 188 Build Insurance Catalogue (Script, static list with status) -> 4
184 WC or MVA? [WC] [MVA] -> 170   [Neither] -> 198 Insurance Dropdown Region? (Logic)
      is_display_insurance_dropdown == 'true' -> 199 Using Insurance? / Select Insurance
      default                                 -> 119 What Benefits? (status quo, four buttons)
199 is_using_insurance Yes/No, insurance_selection (shown on Yes), patient_insurance_other (shown on 10005 Other)
199 -> 200 Route Insurance Selection (Script) -> 201 Insurance Route (Logic)
      self_pay              -> 150 self-pay pricing
      not_accepted_medicaid -> 167 Medicaid not accepted -> 34
      not_accepted_other    -> 3 self-pay rates -> 183 / 155 / 34
      managed               -> 6 call back next month -> 34
      default (accepted)    -> 1 -> 149 Initial Insurance Collect (card radio first, subscriber details)
149 [Add Secondary] -> 186 (secondary dropdown, transforms.insurance_list)
Every exit goes to 34 (Tree -> Incoming Call node 41). The create-insurance POST runs in
Incoming Call (nodes 162-164) after the appointment, because it needs the patient number.

Node map - HSS

189 Gather Doctor Info   - conditional radio referred_to_hss, shown when name contains HSS
190 HSS COE Logic        - name cont HSS -> 191, default -> 120
191 Referred to HSS      - radio hss_referred (Yes/No) -> 120

Two variables hold one fact (referred_to_hss and hss_referred). Collapse to one before anything routes on it. The nearby-clinic list is not built here - it comes from tree 787613344 via nodes 65, 66 and 177, so HSS-only filtering is a change in that tree.

Data dictionary - variables added by this change

  • new_cost_code - the clinic cost code, under the name the Azure object's query string reads. Written by node 1, read only by that Connected Object.
  • clinic_raintree_code - clinic code (e.g. NY181). Node 188 matches it, upper-cased, against INSURANCE_DROPDOWN_CLINICS.
  • is_display_insurance_dropdown - "true"/"false", written by node 188, sends dropdown-clinic calls to node 199 (router 198).
  • insurance_catalog - form data, JSON [{value, label, status}]. Written by node 188, read by node 200.
  • is_using_insurance - node 199 radio, Yes / No. Read by node 200.
  • insurance_list - transform, [{name: label, value: code}], accepted insurances only (Kelsie, 2026-10-08). Written by node 188. Option source for node 186.
  • insurance_selection_list - transform, every catalogue entry. Written by node 188. Option source for node 199.
  • insurance_selection - node 199's pick. Read only by node 200.
  • insurance_route - self_pay / accepted / not_accepted_medicaid / not_accepted_other / managed. Written by node 200, read by router 201.
  • patient_insurance_other - insurance name for the Incoming Call summaries. On the dropdown path node 200 writes the selected label; for 10005 Other the agent types it on node 199.
  • patient_insurance_rt_code - Raintree insurance code (e.g. 10012). Written only by node 200, and only for an accepted insurance (blank otherwise). Incoming Call 162-164 POSTs it. secondary_patient_insurance_rt_code is node 186's pick.

External systems

  • get_token (1021) - Raintree OAuth token.
  • No insurance lookup call any more. raintree__find_master_insurances (1214) and alias_35 are no longer used by this tree; the list is static in node 188.
  • clinicinfoprod (55) - clinic detail and the not-accepted-insurances panel.

Gotchas

  • Clinic gate: only clinics in INSURANCE_DROPDOWN_CLINICS (node 188, 81 codes + ZZZ test clinic) get node 199. New York region codes still to come from Kelsie. Every other region keeps node 119's four buttons and no insurance code is captured, so no insurance is POSTed for them. Everyone else uses the free-text insurance field.
  • node 149 field selected_case_type is a select with no option source. Leftover from the 9/28 session.
  • Kelsie's list repeats 10009 Medicaid Advantage (MDA) and has no 10010. Kept once as 10009; confirm 10010 with her.
  • test-insurance-dev (1260) is a scratch object pointing at /v1/raintree_insurance with an underscore. Not wired to anything. Delete it so nobody picks the wrong one.

Changelog

  • 2026-10-13 - Jami's updated flowchart and the 10/13 Insurance Updates call. 184 is WC / MVA / Neither. 199 asks "Will you be using insurance?" (No -> 150), shows the dropdown on Yes and an insurance-name box for Other. Every dropdown entry carries a status (188 insurance_catalog) and 201 routes on it: accepted -> 149, not_accepted_medicaid -> 167, not_accepted_other -> 3, managed -> 6. Red not-accepted panels removed from 199 and 149. 149 asks for the card first. No-card wording on 149, Medicaid wording on 167, last bullet on 53 per the flowchart. 188 gate is now clinic codes; fixed the match (codes are upper case, the old check lower-cased the input) and added ZZZ. Statuses are static until SharePoint returns name, code and status.
  • 2026-10-08 (pm) - 10/8 Ivy call with Kelsie. Brooklyn / Charlotte calls now pick the insurance on one dropdown (node 199: accepted insurances + Insurance Not Accepted / Medicaid Not Accepted / Private Pay) with one Continue, routed by 200 + 201 instead of four buttons. 184 [Insurance] -> 198 region router; other regions keep 119 as-is. Accepted-list dropdowns removed from 119, 149, 150, 167. Insurance sent to Raintree by code only, so the API-name column and insurance_options are gone.
  • 2026-10-08 - Static insurance list. Node 188 now declares Kelsie's code/name list (insurance_options form data, insurance_list transform); Data node 194 (raintree__find_master_insurances) removed, 31 returns straight to 188. All five insurance dropdowns (119, 149, 150, 167, 186) bound to insurance_list and renamed to patient_insurance_rt_code / secondary_patient_insurance_rt_code. Node 186 was bound to the wrong transform (insurance_select). Unlinked test nodes 195-197 removed; the create-insurance POST lives in Incoming Call 162-164.
  • 2026-09-29 - Node 188: region check was inverted and misspelled ("Brooklynn") - the dropdown was hidden in the three rollout regions and shown everywhere else. Now shown only in Brooklyn / North Charlotte / South Charlotte. Null-safe when alias_35 returns no list (was a script error). Removed the commented 9/17 master-list block.
  • 2026-09-17 - Added node 1 and the Azure object to node 187; rewrote node 188 to choose between the clinic-accepted list and the master list behind a region gate. Requirements: Requirements/Ivy Rehab/schedule-new-patient-appointment-requirements.md CR-3, CR-4.
